title: Boxly storage adapter for the sync engine
name: Cloud storage adapter

locateQuestion.prompt: Is there a defect in how the adapter translates Boxly's responses into the sync engine's domain types? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
locateQuestion.explanation: In BoxlyAdapter.toEntry, `modifiedAt: new Date(c.modified_unix)` passes a Unix timestamp in seconds to the Date constructor, which expects milliseconds. Every remote entry gets a modifiedAt in January 1970, so in planSync the check `entry.modifiedAt > local.modifiedAt` is false for any file that already exists locally: changed remote files whose local copy has no edits are silently never downloaded. The fix is `new Date(c.modified_unix * 1000)`. The adapter boundary is exactly where provider units must be converted to domain units.

choiceQuestions.prompt: Boxly responds to a listChanges call with HTTP 409 and an error body. What does the caller of listChanges observe?
choices: A ProviderError with status 409 and retryable set to false
A ProviderError with status 409 and retryable set to true
A ChangePage with no entries and nextCursor null
A raw SyntaxError, because res.json() fails on the error body
choiceQuestions.explanation: request() returns only when res.ok; otherwise it reads the body text and throws ProviderError with res.status. retryable is true only for 429 or >= 500, so 409 is non-retryable. No empty page is returned, and res.json() is never reached because request() throws first.

choiceQuestions.prompt: The Boxly API hangs and never responds to a download request. What happens?
choices: The call hangs forever because download() has no timeout of its own
After timeoutMs the fetch is aborted and a retryable ProviderError with status 0 is thrown
After timeoutMs a ProviderError with status 504 is thrown
The adapter retries the request until it succeeds
choiceQuestions.explanation: All requests go through request(), which passes AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs). The abort rejects fetch, and the catch block wraps it as ProviderError with status 0 and retryable true. There is no synthetic 504 and the adapter itself does no retries.

choiceQuestions.prompt: planSync crashes partway through the third page of changes. On the next run, where does listing resume?
choices: From the very beginning, since no cursor is saved until all pages finish
From the end of the third page
From the start of the third page, the cursor saved after the second page
From the start of the second page
choiceQuestions.explanation: After each page, planSync saves page.nextCursor before fetching the next page. After page two finishes, the saved cursor points at page three, so a restart re-lists page three. Cursors are saved incrementally, not at the end, and the third page's own nextCursor is never saved because the crash happens before that line.
